why: Author: Eagle_Eyes (observer; no trade advice, no edge claim, no VALIDATION or HOLDOUT).

The top-trader long/short ratios move slowly and opposite to the hours-long price swing (down while price rose from 10-27 16Z to 10-28 10:45Z, up while price fell since), and they did not react to the 1-minute drop at 13:36-13:50; test their lead/lag against…
Reading: understand each layer as a concept first; the working idea is confluence of layers, not one winning layer. No edge is claimed here.
